decision.verdictStatement: ACCEPT. Reviewing to refute, I could not break v4. Thirty-two attacks were run against it - the twenty from the dispatch plus twelve of my own aimed at cross-lineage theft, superseding recordings, verbatim drift, roster arithmetic, and overstated verdicts - and all thirty-two failed. Every one of 44 cited digests reproduces from live bytes; all four cited commits resolve to the decisions claimed; the three currency claims (leftover-join.v3 at draft time, occupancy v5, g16 leftover-join.v4) are each independently true against COORD and the filesystem; required-now is live-28; the DR-121 token is live-OPEN; and the two leftover-design members survive intact and uncontested by the concurrent DR-G16 lineage, which agrees with them rather than absorbing them. The version bump is earned: nine measurement-bearing fields moved, including a real repoint of the G16 specification citation from occupancy v2 to occupancy v5. Three non-blocking observations are logged, each tested for staleness against live bytes before being declined as a finding.
